title: Special Executive Programme In Operations And Information Management For Project Managers
description: Streamline your project success by harnessing cutting-edge techniques in operations and information management to drive efficiency and innovation.
longDescription: The course enables the development of advanced skills in managing operations and information systems crucial for successful project execution. Participants will explore strategic approaches to optimize resources, streamline processes, and leverage data for decision-making. Emphasizing practical applications, the course equips project managers with the tools to enhance operational efficiency and drive project success. Gain a comprehensive understanding of integrating information management into project workflows to achieve superior outcomes.
courseDetails: Capacity Planning for Products and Services, Strategies for Expanding Capacity, and Ways of Defining and Measuring Capacity. Determinants of Effective Capacity, Capacity Constraints, and Bottleneck Theory study. Inventory Management System, its type, importance, commonly used inventories, effective inventory management, and the component of the Inventory Model. ABC Analysis, the Category of ABC Analysis, Why it is Critical to Use ABC Analysis for Inventory Management, How to Conduct an ABC Analysis, Major Applications of ABC Analysis, and Future Trends in ABC Analysis. Economic Order Quantity Model, Assumptions of EOQ, how to use EOQ in your business, Single Period Model, and Types of Single Period Model. Operation Scheduling, its Objectives, functions, and types. Approaches to scheduling and Load Work Centres, along with concept and method of sequencing, performance measures, and minimizing scheduling difficulties. Theory of Constraints including principles, metrics used, Scheduling Services, Scheduling Multiple Resources, and Time–Cost Trade-Offs. Project Quality Management, its three Processes, Quality Management System's importance, Establishing and Implementing a QMS, and its elements. Quality Circle, its characteristics, problems, and phases, along with studying ISO nine thousand or EN twenty-nine thousand, its seven Quality Principles, and most importantly, ISO nine thousand series. Total Quality Management, its Principles, Methods, and Steps, along with understanding the Kaizen or Continuous Improvement concept, its types, and Cycle. The course enables professionals to integrate operations and information management effectively for successful project delivery. It covers key aspects of operations management, including process optimization through Six Sigma and business process reengineering. Participants will understand strategic capacity planning, inventory management, and scheduling, using tools like ABC Analysis and the Economic Order Quantity model. The course also delves into quality management systems, emphasizing continuous improvement through Total Quality Management and the Kaizen approach. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Role of operations in business management: Strategic Capacity Planning in Project Management: Effective Inventory Management: Concept of Scheduling in Supply Chain Operations: Project Quality Management System:
